title: Acid dissociation constants (pKa) of common acids in water at 25 °C
license: Factual values; CRC Handbook tables are copyrighted as a compilation — only a few individual values are reproduced here.
description: Thermodynamic pKa values (extrapolated to zero ionic strength) as tabulated in the CRC Handbook and widely reproduced in textbooks. Approximate: rounded to 2–3 decimals.

uncertainty.note: Values are rounded; literature values differ by up to a few hundredths. Approximate — check the consulted edition before research use.

applicability: Dilute aqueous solutions near 25 °C; activity corrections needed at higher ionic strength.
